This is a documentation subpage for Template:Taxobox/species.
It contains usage information, categories and other content that is not part of the original template page.

Contents

  • 1 Usage
    • 1.1 IUCN2.3
    • 1.2 IUCN3.1
    • 1.3 EPBC
    • 1.4 TNC
    • 1.5 ESA
    • 1.6 COSEWIC
  • 2 Tracking categories

Usage[]

This template is designed for use by

.

{{Taxobox/species|status system parameter|conservation status parameter}}

Returns the conservation code coloured circles and adds categories.

Examples
  • {{Taxobox/species |IUCN2.3 |EX }}
  • {{Taxobox/species |TNC |T5 }}
